summary: Rabbi Tawil examines the events of Yehoshua chapter 7, focusing on the aftermath of the battle of Yericho and the secret transgression of Achan. He discusses the defeat of the Jewish people at Ai and the subsequent dialogue between Yehoshua and Hashem regarding the nation's standing. The class explores the nature of the Herem and the implications of acting against the covenant of Hashem.
questions: Why did the Jewish people lose the battle against Ai?
What was the significance of the Herem in the conquest of Yericho?
Why did Yehoshua challenge Hashem after the defeat?
What does the Torah teach about the difference between public and private theft?
